Variable description: List of authors, organizations for the citation of the data.
Confidence of the analyst about classification of the polygon.
Who to contact for data sharing.

Name of source image, or other ID that can be used to identify the dataset that the

Method used to delineate the polygons.

Variable description: A description of what the polygon dataset represents. Indicate as specifically as possible the name, model and source of the imagery. Indicate if more than one source of imagery was used, if data were collected on multiple days, etc.
DOI if the dataset has one.
Habitat type delineated - seagrass or kelp.
Date that image was acquired.
Spatial resolution/cell size of the orthomosaic from which kelp canopy was digitized.
Sensor that was used for image collection.
Name of the shapefile. Naming convention is YYYYMMDD_Region_ Site_kelp.shp
Name of species being delineated (polygon level).
Link to metadata record or readme.
Hakai MOBE Id which links imagery to a specific mission.
Additional comments from the analyst.
Unique ID from ArcGIS Pro
Larger geographic region where kelp was mapped.
Specific sensor or sensor type that was used for image collection.
Units or variable categories: E.g. DJI Phantom 4 Pro, DJI Phantom 4 Pro Multispectral, Mavic 3E

Perimeter length of the polygon feature.
Name of the survey site.
